SERB SUPRA SERB has developed a scheme SERB-SUPRA (Scientific and Useful Profound 
Research Advancement) that seeks to explore new scientific breakthroughs, with long-term impact on our fundamental scientific understanding, and offer disruptive technologies at the cutting edge.

SERB TETRA SERB-TETRA (Technology Translation Award) is a new scheme for catalizing technology translation in academic setting. TETRA Support will help entities having successful ideas to kickstart new venture processes.
